fullContent:
Vyaghryadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam Chikitsa Sthana 1/61 
 Vyaghryadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine, used for treatment of respiratory conditions like cough, cold and bronchitis. It is herbal decoction. It balances Vata and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Vyaghri – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Amruta – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All herbs are taken in equal parts, added with 8 or 16 parts of water, boiled and reduced to 1/8th part then filtered. 
 Dosage 
 
 Take 5 – 10 ml, before food, or on empty stomach, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is advised to mix the kashayam (decoction) with equal quantity of water. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Running nose 
 Chronic respiratory conditions 
 Fever 
 Rhinitis 
 Asthma 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects of using this medicine. 
 For the diabetic people this medicine should be taken under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
